mapper.select: SELECT HOLIDAY_DATE AS "day", HOLIDAY_NAME AS "name" FROM HOLIDAY_EXTRA ORDER BY HOLIDAY_DATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HOLIDAY_EXTRA (HOLIDAY_DATE, HOLIDAY_NAME, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{day, jdbcType=DATE}, #{name}, #{by}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM HOLIDAY_EXTRA WHERE HOLIDAY_DATE = #{day, jdbcType=DATE}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOLIDAY_EXTRA WHERE HOLIDAY_DATE = #{day, jdbcType=DATE}
